name: Cisco ASA — Internal Web Server Initiating Outbound Connection
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter src_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        dst_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        src_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        dst_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        src_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_interface,
        dst_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
        proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter src_if = "inside" and dst_if = "outside"
       and src_host in ("10.0.10.50", "10.0.10.51", "10.0.10.52", "192.168.110.243")
| alter int_host = src_host, ext_dest = dst_host
| comp sum(bytes_n) as out_bytes,
       values(dst_port) as ext_ports,
       values(src_port) as int_ports,
       values(proto) as protocols
       by int_host, ext_dest
| filter out_bytes >= 10000
| fields int_host, ext_dest, ext_ports, int_ports, protocols, out_bytes
description: Cisco ASA Built/Teardown event where the internal host (xdm.target.ipv4) is a known web/app server IP making outbound — reversal of normal traffic direction indicates compromise.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Internal Web Server Initiating Outbound Connection
alert_description:
What fired: Cisco ASA Built/Teardown event where the internal host (xdm.target.ipv4) is a known web/app server IP making outbound — reversal of normal traffic direction indicates compromise.

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071 - Application Layer Protocol (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (int_host) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
